title: Strength and service stiffness sets
purpose: Two copies of a 10-story core-and-frame tower, 60 ft apart: one with cracked-section modifiers for strength (columns 0.7, beams 0.35, walls 0.35) and one with the service set (1.4 times those, ACI 318 6.6.3.2.2). The same lateral load on each: the service tower drifts about 1/1.4 as much.

settings.endOffsets: off (ETABS automatic end length offsets disabled, forces reported joint to joint)
settings.modifiers: strength set on tower S, service set (x1.4) on tower V
settings.shells: core walls Shell-Thin with membrane and bending modifiers
settings.diaphragm: rigid, each floor of each tower
